svg.aria-label: Animated expected behaviour of the two-hand start
svg.title: Expected behaviour of the two-hand start
svg.text: Teal outline = that contact is true now. STOP_PB is true while the STOP button is NOT pressed.
Idle: no buttons pressed, motor OFF
LEFT and RIGHT together: motor ON
RIGHT released: the motor stops immediately
STOP pressed: motor OFF at once
STOP released, both still held: nothing is latched, the motor runs again
